title: Room Tier Pricing Held Nights in the Resident Funds Spare Balance
content:
Held nights building up on a hold in progress under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations reduce the spare balance of a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account before an ancillary per-bill authorization amount is set; each such night is at the bed-hold rate of **the room tier priced**. The room tier priced follows the hold in progress:

| Records | Room tier priced |
|---|---|
| the reservation records the room tier held | that tier, because a held bed is priced at the tier of the room held |
| the reservation records none, and the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement records an isolation placement the center directed | the agreement's isolation billing tier |
| otherwise | the room tier of the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement |

Where neither records a room tier, no night is priced.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Reservation's room tier held | Agreement's tier | Center-directed isolation placement | Tier priced |
|---|---|---|---|
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Private Suite with Sitting Area | yes | Private Bariatric Care Room |
| none | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | yes | the agreement's isolation billing tier |
| none | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | no | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
